actions.action: Check whether the plant gets enough bright indirect light
Move the plant into more sunshine / bright indirect light
Assess whether you are underwatering or overwatering

verdict.reason: The scraped comments focus on sunlight and only ask whether the owner is under- or overwatering, without identifying thirst; they offer no watering fix, and the reassurance that the plant looks fantastic, along with 'water it on occasion', could delay the needed watering.
